body:
Final repaired candidate publication is prepared under the existing #3102 owner direction6144374034, post-step5 end-to-end hold6146782845 and user-authorized remaining-roadmap takeover6166924147. This is the complete final profile after genuine code repairs, not a per-slice experiment or a retry of unchanged d824. No new approval or threshold is introduced.

Head `3cdf6ee16c6c543cd7933f7a7d24cff407328d56`, tree `dc778399c63a2cdd3e3c0b7b8cc3aec8f84f9e08`, has single code parent `056bb69aecf3db4f2720ab82adee99cc800f5f45` / tree `d2594fa48efe985600f071d357aec62abb1e9044`. The request-only commit appends exactly three lines, AST selector3→4, preserves the entire old request byte-prefix and inherited frontend-nesting/foreign request histories, and changes no compiler/build source. Request SHA256 `97222cf4fcde6990278b683e222e36fda3d5946be87361f8ad3106221e059285`.

Actual protected main is `02a6414e020f5d549122197c3a7c8407df5bed76` / tree `5aa95687f3d2056f07760ae0347d200b06c84eee`, verified again before request preparation. Genuine merges retain all #4267 dead-arm/condition-effect/label-entry and #4294 inline-planning changes, every existing roadmap contract and every original fixture. Independent final composition review SHA256 `4d9eaa528fcbc9a1af60b5923ac94d60272a7f51698e3bdcbc30cfa1dde2b076` found no source blocker. Eighteen trusted measurement contract files at expected tooling02a are byte-identical to qualified RSS repair67b5; rebind SHA256 `d585a2ccc541dffe8faa99cc208aab870b8c459275fe91ef7d36c3cb2d35dfeb`. Actual executor T must still be audited.

Private code repairs remove out-of-bracket classification, unnecessary widefloat/layout work, redundant fact discovery and guarded existing TYPE_NAME requerying. Their own full frontend/AST, mode, object/effect and matched local instruction records pass; these are component evidence only. The TYPE_NAME census/state proof retains 27,883 exact base/final answers and six scalar-root outputs with no appended rows, while all refusal/closed/suspended/uncached/pending-failure cases retain the original semantic path. No proportional, wall-time or target-host speed claim is made.

Fresh actual02a baseline qualification is complete: byte-identical42,298,040-byte self-host fixed point, original machine/bench ceilings, and new848-endpoint baseline(776objects/72rejections) independently verified. Baseline handoff SHA256 `4f817bc8afda0b1c22b7704c136dc4971a40a535c60a9718ddc0c48aeaf4380a`. Full composed local/hosted/private-candidate gates remain PENDING and run alongside physical preparation; no old d824 or component qualification is substituted.

The original20cells/800rows default/default approved9700X profile remains unchanged. Final acceptance still requires actual H/B/T, all raw source/binary/input/environment/reference/counter/RSS/retained-census bindings, native floor/ownership/bootstrap/cleanup proof, independent publisher/seal replay and measured disposition, followed by exact-head/protected-group gates and actual main containment. Wall/instructions describe compiler plus native RSS observer without subtraction. Ordinary legacy-route RSS stays separate. Queue/adoption remain held until disposition.

The complete d824/e51 experiment remains VALID but ADVERSE and unadopted, with its immutable historical audit/capsule commit `a2a5b960b06de29ec77eac17acafa9dcbb45d231` retained for the docs companion. Failed c90/H2 and H3 history is preserved. Already-closed #4058 is not a waiver. Wider #3102/#2715/#1313/#4282 and other owner residuals remain distinct.

Buster first-party license remains unselected/NOASSERTION per LICENSES/README.md and #621; no external implementation is imported.
